responsibility: This file implements the Fortran front end’s compile-time arithmetic engine and constant conversions using GMP/MPFR/MPC to model target arithmetic on the host. It initializes kind-dependent numeric limits, performs range checking and constant folding support for scalar and array expressions, evaluates arithmetic/logical/comparison operations, and handles cross-kind conversions including Hollerith/character reinterpretation helpers that consume gfc_expr constants and produce folded constant expressions or diagnostics for overflow, NaN, divide-by-zero, truncation, and invalid type combinations.
same_name_distinction: Implements the arithmetic subsystem itself: the MPFR/GMP-backed folding, range checking, comparisons, and concrete conversion routines such as Hollerith/character reinterpretation. Unlike gcc/fortran/arith.h, this is the executable implementation rather than the interface declaration layer.
